correctness.rationale: The radius derivative is obtained by implicit differentiation of the angle-closure equation. The gradient and Hessian follow by differentiating the signed fan-area formula. The determinant lemma and chamber-specific cotangent signs prove nonsingularity; homogeneity and the rank-one decomposition prove exactly one positive eigenvalue and \(n-1\) negative eigenvalues. The proof excludes the semicyclic boundary explicitly.
